Interface InvitationRoles

All Known Implementing Classes:
RbacInvitationRoles
public interface InvitationRoles
Gives an invited identity its roles, for InvitationService. Roles live in who-rbac, which who-email-link does not need: who's autoconfiguration supplies an RbacInvitationRoles when who-rbac is on the classpath, and without one an invitation may carry no roles.

      void assign(Identity identity, Set<String> roleNames)
      Assigns the named roles to the identity, inside the caller's transaction, so a failure rolls the invitation back.
      Parameters:
      identity - the invited identity
      roleNames - the names of the roles to assign; not empty
      Throws:
      InvalidInvitationException - if a name names no role
